title: Cu(II) traceability in industrial samples: innovating detection with modified nanoparticles and magnetic electrodes
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00459K, Paper
C. Costa, D. Talbot, A. Bée, S. Abramson, V. Diz, G. A. González
This paper presents a novel approach for the sensitive detection of Cu(II) ions in acidic industrial samples, used in the manufacture of printed circuits.
